repeats.name: Nassim
repeats.line: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

repeats.name: Caleb
repeats.line: "Okay. Yeah. I trust you."

repeats.name: Caleb
repeats.line: A neutral quiet returns, the kind where words land normally.

repeats.name: Masego
repeats.line: "Take it with salt. What did you want to ask? Give it time."

repeats.name: Nassim
repeats.line: "The old you got you here. The new you keeps you here. Both count."

repeats.name: Caleb
repeats.line: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

repeats.name: Jorge
repeats.line: Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.

repeats.name: Nassim
repeats.line: "Shock's underrated. It's the body's way of buying you time."

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: "That's what I heard, anyway. What's up?"

repeats.name: Nassim
repeats.line: "Still on the others. That's still where we are."

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: "Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.

repeats.name: Mara
repeats.line: "That's what I heard, anyway. What's up? That's my read."

repeats.name: Caleb
repeats.line: "Hm. Never mind — go on."

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: "Like I said — Still on the others."

repeats.name: Nassim
repeats.line: Quiet. "Yeah. I think everyone's carrying one of those."

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: "As I said — Still on the others."

repeats.name: Jorge
repeats.line: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

repeats.name: Tashi
repeats.line: "Still on that favor."
